## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.7

This alpha improves dashboard pairing while allowing independent editor sessions on PC and PS5 browsers.

### Changed
- **Reuse a pending pairing code:** when the original six-digit code is still valid and unused, a new request resends that exact code. The initial 120-second expiration and failed-attempt counter do not reset. A 10-second minimum interval prevents repeated notifications; generating a new PIN preserves the original 60-second request cooldown.
- **Do not request a code from an authorized browser page:** after successful pairing, the button displays “Editing already enabled” and becomes disabled. The API also rejects re-pairing from a page that presents its already-valid session token.
- **Independent browser sessions:** up to eight separate one-hour in-memory session tokens can coexist. Pairing on another device does not invalidate a previously authorized device. Expired sessions free their slots; no valid session is silently evicted.
- **Safe concurrent configuration editing:** the original configuration-version check and atomic save process remain intact. Changes based on stale versions are refused.
- **Session validation:** the dashboard checks its own token upon returning to Settings and periodically. Once expired, it hides editor controls and offers pairing again.

### Validation
Host tests cover reusing the same PIN, preserving its expiry and failed-attempt count, one-use PIN consumption, independent editor tokens, session expiration, lockout behavior, stale configuration edits and browser interface states. PS5 SDK build runs in CI.

**Alpha notice:** validate notifications, expiry and simultaneous PC/PS5-browser pairing on actual hardware. The backup and USB migration algorithms and saved data are unchanged.

Based on [heni0xyz/PS5Save](https://github.com/heni0xyz/PS5Save). GPL-3.0.
